title: An integer multiplicity triple carried by a Borel subset of a rectifiable set with tangent data (Simon Ch. 6, Definition 4.4)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and Hⁿ := μHE[n]. Let A ⊆ S ⊆ ℝ^P be Borel sets with S countably n-rectifiable; let θ : ℝ^P → ℕ be Borel with θ(x) > 0 for every x ∈ S and ∫_{S∩K} θ dHⁿ < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P; and let ζ : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n (n-vectors, the continuous linear functionals on n-covectors) be a.e. strongly measurable for Hⁿ⌞A. Assume that for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ A there is a linear subspace Q of ℝ^P such that S has approximate tangent space Q at x (SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n S x Q) and ζ(x) is a unit orientation of Q (contract IsUnitOrientationOf). Then (A, θ, ζ) is an integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P of dimension n: there is R : IMRep univ n with R.carrier = A, R.mult = θ and R.orient = ζ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A S : Set (Euclid P)) (θ : Euclid P → ℕ) (ζ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet S → A ⊆ S → CountablyRectifiable n S → Measurable θ → (∀ x ∈ S, 0 < θ x) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ∫⁻ x in S ∩ K, (θ x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ζ (μHE[n].restrict A) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict A), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n S x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (ζ x) Q) → ∃ R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R.carrier = A ∧ R.mult = θ ∧ R.orient = ζ
